Messages.Body:
Howler cannot use weapons.
But she can equip/have weapons.
In the past, this has led to a thread about a peculiar interaction between
her and Talbot's chainsaw.

The question is this:
If Howler equips with a Dagger, can she use its text to get a second one?

My gut instinct is "no". Especially because I had to use the word "use" in
my question :)
